items.title: Matchday details and safer participation controls
items.summary: Liga do Povo replaced the older match detail treatment with an interactive matchday board and made participation controls reflect the actual game state.

items.title: Recurring game discovery and directory trust
items.summary: The pickup directory was expanded around recurring community games, clearer participation rules, and more reliable regional discovery.

items.title: Stable recurring-game links during outages
items.summary: Recurring game identifiers were made deterministic so a known game keeps the same link when the shared backend is unavailable.

items.title: Runtime checks distinguish failures from unavailable providers
items.summary: Au Jour Le Jour hardened its Janitor runtime checks so provider outages, quota limits, and missing connections are not reported as application defects unless live-provider availability is required.

items.title: Readable, recoverable household-ledger backups
items.summary: Au Jour Le Jour added a portable HTML backup that can be read without the application while retaining the original importable data.
